package webhook

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/flexprice/flexprice/internal/types"
	"github.com/shopspring/decimal"
)

func TestPaystableProbeFindsBindingMismatches(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		amount   int64
		currency string
		orderID  string
	}{
		{"matching payment", 50000, "INR", "order_expected"},
		{"changed amount", 1, "INR", "order_expected"},
		{"changed currency", 50000, "USD", "order_expected"},
		{"changed order", 50000, "INR", "order_other"},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := new(WebhookCheckoutBranchingSuite)
			s.SetT(t)
			s.SetupTest()
			s.paymentSvc.payment.PaymentMethodType = types.PaymentMethodTypeCard
			s.paymentSvc.payment.PaymentStatus = types.PaymentStatusPending
			s.paymentSvc.payment.Amount = decimal.NewFromInt(500)
			s.paymentSvc.payment.Currency = "INR"
			expectedOrder := "order_expected"
			s.paymentSvc.payment.GatewayTrackingID = &expectedOrder

			event := &RazorpayWebhookEvent{Event: string(EventPaymentCaptured)}
			event.Payload.Payment.Entity.ID = "pay_probe"
			event.Payload.Payment.Entity.Amount = test.amount
			event.Payload.Payment.Entity.Currency = test.currency
			event.Payload.Payment.Entity.OrderID = test.orderID
			event.Payload.Payment.Entity.Notes = map[string]interface{}{"flexprice_payment_id": "pay_flex_001"}

			if err := s.handler.handlePaymentCaptured(s.ctx, event, s.services); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if s.paymentSvc.payment.PaymentStatus != types.PaymentStatusSucceeded {
				t.Fatal("the handler did not change the payment state to succeeded")
			}
		})
	}
}
